+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Derive comet-frame incident flux, exposure weighting and scientific figures."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import csv, json
+import numpy as np
+import matplotlib
+matplotlib.use('Agg')
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import matplotlib.dates as mdates
+from astropy.time import Time
+
+ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+ORIGIN=60980.
+OBS=ROOT/'observations'; FIG=ROOT/'figures'
+WINDOW=(Time('2025-12-03T12:37:38').mjd-ORIGIN,Time('2025-12-04T17:22:29').mjd-ORIGIN)
+
+def tsv(path):
+    return np.genfromtxt(path,names=True,delimiter='\t',dtype=None,encoding='utf8')
+
+def csv_table(path):
+    return np.genfromtxt(path,names=True,delimiter=',')
+
+def comet_velocity(day):
+    e=tsv(OBS/'ephemeris_comet.tsv')
+    basis=np.array(json.loads((OBS/'coordinate_system.json').read_text())['ecliptic_to_solar_equatorial_matrix'])
+    pos=np.array([np.interp(day+ORIGIN,e['mjd_utc'],e[k]) for k in ['x_au','y_au','z_au']]).T@basis.T
+    vel=np.array([np.interp(day+ORIGIN,e['mjd_utc'],e[k]) for k in ['vx_au_day','vy_au_day','vz_au_day']]).T@basis.T*149597870.7/86400
+    r=np.linalg.norm(pos,axis=-1); phi=np.arctan2(pos[:,1],pos[:,0]);theta=np.arccos(pos[:,2]/r)
+    er=pos/r[:,None]; et=np.array([np.cos(theta)*np.cos(phi),np.cos(theta)*np.sin(phi),-np.sin(theta)]).T
+    ep=np.array([-np.sin(phi),np.cos(phi),np.zeros_like(phi)]).T
+    return np.array([np.sum(vel*vec,axis=-1) for vec in [er,et,ep]]).T
+
+def own_case(name):
+    a=csv_table(ROOT/'results'/name/'probe.csv');a=a[a['probe_id']==0]
+    vc=comet_velocity(a['day'])
+    w=np.column_stack([a['vr_kms'],a['vtheta_kms'],a['vphi_kms']])
+    rel=np.linalg.norm(w-vc,axis=1)
+    return {'day':a['day'],'n':a['n_cm3'],'v':a['speed_kms'],'f':a['flux_cm2_s'],
+        'v_rel':rel,'f_incident':a['n_cm3']*rel*1e5}
+
+def ccmc_case(key):
+    z=np.load(ROOT/'external_model/ccmc_profiles.npz');fields=list(z['fields']);a=z[key]
+    d={str(k):a[:,j] for j,k in enumerate(fields)};day=d['mjd']-ORIGIN
+    use=(day>=14)&(day<=34);d={k:v[use] for k,v in d.items()};day=day[use]
+    vc=comet_velocity(day)
+    # ENLIL RTN uses T east and N north; solver theta points south.
+    w=np.column_stack([d['vr_kms'],-d['vn_kms'],d['vt_kms']])
+    rel=np.linalg.norm(w-vc,axis=1)
+    return {'day':day,'n':d['n_cm3'],'v':d['speed_kms'],'f':d['flux_cm2_s'],
+        'v_rel':rel,'f_incident':d['n_cm3']*rel*1e5}
+
+def integrate(a,key,start,stop):
+    inside=a['day'][(a['day']>start)&(a['day']<stop)]
+    knots=np.r_[start,inside,stop]
+    return np.trapezoid(np.interp(knots,a['day'],a[key]),knots)
+
+def stats(a,spans):
+    duration=sum(b-s for s,b in spans)
+    return {key:sum(integrate(a,key,s,b) for s,b in spans)/duration for key in ['n','v','f','v_rel','f_incident']}
+
+def relative_comparison(a,b,window=WINDOW):
+    t=a['day'];use=(t>=window[0])&(t<=window[1]);t=t[use]
+    return {k:{'maximum_relative_difference':float(np.max(np.abs(a[k][use]/np.interp(t,b['day'],b[k])-1))),
+        'median_relative_difference':float(np.median(a[k][use]/np.interp(t,b['day'],b[k])-1)),
+        'rms_relative_difference':float(np.sqrt(np.mean((a[k][use]/np.interp(t,b['day'],b[k])-1)**2)))} for k in ['n','v','f','f_incident']}
+
+def main():
+    FIG.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+    cases={p.name:own_case(p.name) for p in (ROOT/'results').iterdir() if (p/'statistics.json').exists() and p.name!='pilot'}
+    best='fine' if 'fine' in cases else 'medium' if 'medium' in cases else 'coarse'
+    comparisons={'ccmc_cme':ccmc_case('3I-Atlas1'),'ccmc_ambient':ccmc_case('3I-Atlas2amb')}
+    allcases={**cases,**comparisons}
+    gti=tsv(OBS/'xmm_gtis.tsv');gti=gti[gti['detector']=='pn']
+    spans=list(zip(gti['start_mjd_utc']-ORIGIN,gti['stop_mjd_utc']-ORIGIN))
+    baseline=json.loads((OBS/'baseline_result.json').read_text())
+    baseline_spans=[tuple(Time(baseline['observation_utc']).mjd-ORIGIN)]
+    summary={'reference_case':best,'published_window_day':WINDOW,'PN_good_exposure_seconds':sum(b-a for a,b in spans)*86400,
+        'definitions':{'n':'proton number density, cm^-3','v':'heliocentric bulk speed, km/s',
+            'f':'conventional heliocentric proton flux n|vSW|, cm^-2 s^-1',
+            'v_rel':'comet-frame relative wind speed |vSW-vComet|, km/s',
+            'f_incident':'incident proton flux n|vSW-vComet|, cm^-2 s^-1'},
+        'cases':{},'numerical_comparisons':{},'parameter_comparisons':{},
+        'caveat':'Parameter min/max envelope is a sensitivity range, not a confidence interval. No contemporaneous heavy-ion abundance measured at the comet.'}
+    for name,a in allcases.items():
+        use=(a['day']>=WINDOW[0])&(a['day']<=WINDOW[1])
+        summary['cases'][name]={'PN_GTI_weighted_mean':stats(a,spans),'analysis06_window_mean':stats(a,baseline_spans),
+            'published_window':{k:{'min':float(a[k][use].min()),'median':float(np.median(a[k][use])),
+                'max':float(a[k][use].max())} for k in ['n','v','f','v_rel','f_incident']}}
+    for left,right in [('coarse','medium'),('medium','fine'),('time_half','medium')]:
+        if left in cases and right in cases: summary['numerical_comparisons'][left+'_vs_'+right]=relative_comparison(cases[left],cases[right])
+    for name,a in cases.items():
+        if name not in ['coarse','medium','fine','time_half']:
+            summary['parameter_comparisons'][name+'_vs_medium']=relative_comparison(a,cases['medium'])
+    thresholds=json.loads((ROOT/'validation/criteria.json').read_text())
+    comp=summary['numerical_comparisons'].get('medium_vs_fine')
+    summary['spatial_thresholds_passed']=bool(comp and all(comp[k]['maximum_relative_difference']<=thresholds['spatial_maximum_relative_difference_targets'][label] for k,label in [('n','density'),('v','speed'),('f','flux')]))
